description: Creates a service request for a provider slug and job description. Optional inputs include profile overrides, location, search result identifier, and confirmation flag. Requires authentication. Unauthenticated requests return status "auth_required". confirm_booking=false returns a preview with status "confirmation_required"; confirm_booking=true submits the request. Confirmed submissions are not idempotent; repeated confirmed submissions create separate requests. Returns booking status, identifiers, links, and notification statuses.

BookingLocationInput.description: Optional geocoding hint for addresses without coordinates, in one supported form.

lat.description: Latitude; paired with lng or lon
lat.title: Lat

text.description: City and state text (e.g. "Alexandria, VA") to resolve coordinates
text.title: Text

BookingLocationInput.title: BookingLocationInput

HomeownerAddressInput.description: Optional street-level address override; the authenticated profile address is used otherwise.

address1.description: Street line 1 (e.g. 123 Main St). Required when overriding address.
address1.title: Address1

HomeownerAddressInput.title: HomeownerAddressInput

address.description: Optional street-level address override. The authenticated homeowner profile address is used otherwise. Accepted fields are address1, address2, city, region, postalCode, and country; formattedAddress is output only.

confirm_booking.description: false (default) returns booking_summary without submitting. true submits the booking.
confirm_booking.title: Confirm Booking

context.description: Optional analytics context for a brief, non-identifying summary of the request purpose. The value is recorded as Agent Intent.
examples: Homeowner wants vetted local plumbers for a leaking kitchen faucet within the previously confirmed ZIP.
Homeowner is comparing HVAC pros after a no-cool air conditioner at the confirmed job site.
context.title: Context

location.description: Optional geocoding hint when address lacks coordinates; the profile address is used otherwise. Accepted forms: lat+lng, zip, or text (e.g. {"text": "Alexandria, VA"}).

name.description: Optional name override; the authenticated homeowner profile supplies the value otherwise
name.title: Name

phone.description: Optional phone override; the authenticated homeowner profile supplies the value otherwise
phone.title: Phone

search_result_id.description: Search result identifier associated with the selected provider. Required for confirmed out-of-market bookings.
search_result_id.title: Search Result Id
